verdictStatement: THE DERIVATION IS EXACT AND THE BLOCKING FINDING IT WAS BUILT TO REPAIR IS REPAIRED. I wrote my own resolver, sharing no code with the artifact or any checker, and reproduced $.resolvedValue.sha256 = 2d20119bf8444dbab81a044ba505db9b01da01187c5c41b6d27c0ebd0fd53a8a over exactly 156198 canonical bytes on the first attempt, with all six from-guards compared type-exact and bool BEFORE int, both adds absence-checked, and a duplicate-key-rejecting hook at every parse. I reproduced the predecessor's published figure too, 324845b22b3b1aed0dca9deb8fbc032048dc1399da967062c9103332f06aba41 over 156172 bytes. Exactly four resolved leaves differ from versioning-policy.v14 and all four are successor identity; exactly four operation-list leaves differ ignoring the why fields; operation 6 is strictly equal under a type-exact comparator. The leaf census reproduces in all ten categories and the newly published depth convention checks out both ways. B-VER14R-01 IS REPAIRED AND I TESTED IT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: all 30 keyLocator entries are correct, the measured collision set is exactly the six claimed, five coincide and one differs, and ZERO keys are misdescribed in either direction - no key is told it is absent when present, and none is told it collides when it does not. The central negative claim holds under my own measurement: zero apparatus keys in the delta file and zero in the resolved value. Every residual that must stay open is open, nothing is overstated, no decision id is introduced as a key at any depth, and the file binds nothing and constitutes nothing. WHAT I FOUND IS NOT IN THE CONTRACT AND NOT IN THE DERIVATION. It is in the artifact's account of its own repair. This file exists in part to correct a count its predecessor got wrong - eleven where the truth is nine - and it publishes that correction as complete and as measured. Both halves are false on the bytes. The corrected figure survives at a fourth authored position, $.keyLocator.successorRevision, which this pass wrote fresh and which the sweep's own position enumeration omits; and the sweep publishes a measurement of how far the wrong figure spread, 'eight times', where the file it measures carries it in 11 distinct leaves and 12 occurrences. Separately the file contradicts itself three statements to two on how many non-blocking observations it closes, with the contradicting header sitting directly above the enumeration that refutes it. These are cheap to repair, they touch no contract leaf and they do not move the resolved digest. They are blocking because freeze section 7.2.2 makes a recorded measurement the bindable kind and requires it to be compared before publication, and because the direction of a wrong figure at a reader-facing navigation surface is documented in this very lineage: v14 wrote 'eleven', its independent reviewer restated it and published a claim to have verified eleven blocker titles against a block carrying nine, and the figure 'eight times' had already propagated into the dispatch that commissioned this review before I measured it.

whatWouldClearThisVerdict.theShapeIsRight: I want to be unambiguous, because five predecessors were rejected and a sixth rejection would be easy to reach for. This artifact is not a sixth instance of what sank v9 through v13. Those were standalone re-authors that transcribed a reviewed contract and built machinery to prove the transcription faithful, and every one of the nine blocking findings is against that machinery. This file transcribes nothing, builds no machinery, and the blocking finding raised against its predecessor is repaired exactly and completely at all thirty positions. The derivation is correct, the digest reproduces, the residuals are open, nothing is overstated, and the authority discipline is clean.
whatWouldClearThisVerdict.whatIsOwed: Two corrections, both to prose in the delta file, neither touching a contract leaf, an operation, a guard or the resolved digest. Correct the count at $.keyLocator.successorRevision and the position enumeration and propagation figure that accompany it; correct the three statements that say one observation was closed when two were. A successor making only those changes would, on my measurement, resolve to a digest differing from this one at no leaf of the resolved value at all - because every position involved lives in the delta file's navigation surfaces, which no operation touches.
whatWouldClearThisVerdict.aWarningAboutTheRepair: The obvious remedy - build something that recomputes these figures so they cannot drift - is the trap this lineage fell into five times, and the artifact's own knownLimitations[6] names it correctly: deriving the collision set would require a companion checker, and a companion checker is what every one of the nine blocking findings is about. The right repair here is to recompute the figures by hand from the finished bytes and publish the row counts, not to build an instrument to prove they were recomputed.
